title: 第二十五章 再探渊海柳秉玄登门第二十六章 示好求仙
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
“玄古，莫要鲁莽，渊海以南那可是有万里毒瘴的，蚀骨焚心！若是侵入元神，伤不可愈！”
此言一出，刚刚还要跟玄古斗法的三位长老不住皱了皱眉头，提点似的说道。
纵有嫌隙，但为宗门计，他们亦不愿见玄古折损于此。
渊海那万里毒瘴极为诡异，可消磨法力，修行之人步入其中倍受压制，修为低者压制尚小，反倒是修为越高，受到的影响越大。若本身弱小，力量缩减一些或许没什么影响。但若是一个人强大的久了，骤然抽干大部分力量，或许连路都不会走了。若瘴毒侵入元神，更将造成不可挽回的根基之损……凶险万分，稍有不慎，便是身死道消！
正因如此，此番域外探索，太华宗派遣的皆是年轻弟子。
成长起来的天才才叫天才。
这些弟子固然重要，但论起他们对于宗门的价值，一百个楚湘云也不及一个玄古。
玄古挑了挑眉：“那又如何？”
“你！”
眼见又要争吵，居于中心的太华宗主云枢缓缓睁开眼睛，纯白的双目之中看不到瞳仁，静静的看着玄古：“你要去，便去罢。”
一位长老欲要劝阻：“宗主，这……”
可云枢却转过头来，又看向他：“萧正，你亦同去，二人也可互相照应。”
萧正：……
劝谏不成，反把自己也搭进去了。
云枢平淡的语声传入心间：“俊峰亦是你的弟子。他在等你去救，莫要令他失望。”
一边的玄古不住幸灾乐祸似的笑道：“哈哈哈~怎的，萧正，你怕死？”
萧正瞪了他一眼，又看向云枢：“宗主，可我祁源峰……”
“无妨，我可替你照看着。”
这趟差是必须要出了。
萧正无法，也只好应下：“是！”

云枢袖袍轻轻一甩，道流光闪过，一枚碧玉宝珠凭空悬浮。珠身光华流转，柔和温润的力量弥漫开来，仿佛置身于极致美好之境，令人如沐春风，心念澄明。
碧玉宝珠伴随着阵阵清风，缓缓落至两人跟前。
“此路凶险，这是碧空珠，宗门弟子修为不足，无法驱使，由你保管，可通过此物随时与吾联络。若在毒瘴之中遇险，可使之吸纳方圆十里毒瘴，予尔等一刻钟全力施为。”
萧正一愣：“碧空珠……这是无相禅宗的东西。”
云枢淡声道：“仙盟关注此事，吾已与慧祖相商，借得此物。”
这件事看来比预想之中的要大。
仙盟竟然如此关注开拓渊海之事。
萧正皱了皱眉头，应下来：“是。”
云枢又转眼看向幸灾乐祸的玄古：“玄古，你只求心念通达，无有挂碍。然事关宗门，此行须听萧正之命。”
玄古的性子当不了领袖，如果遇到了什么难以预料之事也不能代表宗门决策。
所以他才一定要让老成持重的萧正也跟着去，组成没头脑不高兴组合。一则二人有所照应，二则要拴住玄古，莫要让他捅了篓子。
“额……”
玄古笑容收敛，但是在云枢的压力下，也只得应下：“是！”
“去罢……”
“是！”
流光闪过，几人身影消失。
content_en:
"Xuan Gu, don't be reckless. There is a poisonous miasma thousands of miles south of the Abyssal Sea, which will corrode bones and burn hearts! If it invades the soul, the injury will not be healed!"
As soon as these words came out, the three elders who had just fought with Xuan Gu couldn't help but frowned and said as if to remind them.
Even if there is a rift, it is for the sake of the sect, and they do not want to see Xuan Gu suffer from this.
The ten thousand miles of poisonous miasma in the Abyssal Sea is extremely strange and can consume mana. Those who practice it will be greatly suppressed when they step into it. Those with low cultivation level will be less suppressed. On the contrary, the higher the cultivation level, the greater the impact will be. If you are weak, reducing your strength may not have any impact. But if a person has been strong for a long time and suddenly loses most of his strength, he may not even be able to walk. If the miasma invades the soul, it will cause irreparable damage to the foundation... It is extremely dangerous, and if you are not careful, you will die!
Because of this, the Taihua Sect sent young disciples for this out-of-territory exploration.
A genius who grows up is called a genius.
Although these disciples are important, when it comes to their value to the sect, one hundred Chu Xiangyun is not as good as one Xuangu.
Xuan Gu raised his eyebrows: "So what?"
"You!"
Seeing that there was going to be another argument, Yun Shu, the leader of Taihua Sect in the center, slowly opened his eyes. There were no pupils visible in his pure white eyes, and he looked at Xuan Gu quietly: "If you want to go, just go."
An elder wanted to dissuade him: "Sect Master, this..."
But Yunshu turned his head and looked at him again: "Xiao Zheng, you are going too, so we can take care of each other."
Xiao Zheng:......
The remonstrance failed, but he got involved himself.
Yunshu's calm voice came into his heart: "Junfeng is also your disciple. He is waiting for you to save him. Don't disappoint him."
Xuan Gu on the side couldn't help but gloated and said with a smile: "Hahaha~ What's the matter, Xiao Zheng, are you afraid of death?"
Xiao Zheng glared at him and then looked at Yunshu: "Sect Master, but I, Qi Yuanfeng..."
"It doesn't matter, I can take care of it for you."
This business trip must go out.
Xiao Zheng had no choice but to agree: "Yes!"
Yunshu flicked his sleeves and robe, a stream of light flashed through, and a jasper orb floated out of thin air. The brilliance of the pearl body flows, and the soft and gentle power spreads out, as if you are in an extremely beautiful state, making you feel like you are bathed in the spring breeze, and your mind is clear.
Accompanied by the breeze, the jasper orb slowly fell in front of the two of them.
"This road is dangerous. This is the Blue Sky Bead. The disciples of the sect are not strong enough to drive it. It is kept by you. You can contact me at any time through this object. If you are in danger in the poisonous miasma, you can make it absorb the poisonous miasma within a radius of ten miles. I will give you a quarter of an hour to use your full strength."
Xiao Zheng was stunned: "The Blue Sky Pearl... this is something from the Wuxiang Zen Sect."
Yun Shu said quietly: "The Immortal Alliance is paying attention to this matter. I have negotiated with Hui Zu and borrowed this thing."
This thing seems to be bigger than expected.
The Immortal Alliance is so concerned about opening up the Abyssal Sea.
Xiao Zheng frowned and responded: "Yes."
Yunshu turned his eyes and looked at Xuan Gu who was gloating about his misfortune: "Xuan Gu, you just want your mind to be clear and have no worries. However, this matter concerns the sect, and you must obey Xiao Zheng's orders for this trip."
Xuan Gu's temperament makes him unable to be a leader, and he cannot make decisions on behalf of the sect if something unexpected happens.
That's why he had to let the mature and prudent Xiao Zheng follow him to form a brainless and unhappy combination. On the one hand, the two of them have to take care of each other, and on the other hand, they must tie up Xuan Gu and not let him get into trouble.
"Um..."
Xuan Gu's smile faded, but under Yunshu's pressure, he had no choice but to agree: "Yes!"
"Just go..."
"Yes!"
A stream of light flashed past, and several figures disappeared.
